lifecycle_policy.DEGRADED: service score, verdict, or required-service evidence is weak
lifecycle_policy.NEW: limited evidence and no negative history
lifecycle_policy.QUARANTINED: rollback/failure evidence or hard service gaps require operator review
lifecycle_policy.RECOVERING: previous negative evidence exists but current signal has improved
lifecycle_policy.TRUSTED: strong current service score plus recent successful channel feedback
lifecycle_policy.WATCH: usable current score but positive channel history is still thin
